description: List parliamentary questions by year and work_type or retrieve metadata, source-file links and published answers with mode get and question_id. Human citations such as E-000001/2025 retain their full year; omission of term checks canonical candidates for every overlapping parliamentary term and requires one verified match. Supply term to disambiguate; canonical IDs resolve directly. Use euparl_list_reference topic question_types for work_type codes. No keyword, author or addressee search is available. Empty answers means no answer relation was published in this response. Get rejects list filters and nondefault paging; continue lists with page.next_offset.

language.description: Supported EU ISO-639-1 language, case-insensitive; default en; source text is never translated.

limit.description: Whole items requested; default 20, effective maximum 100 with notice.

mode.description: Default list discovers questions; get requires question_id and forbids year and work_type.

question_id.description: Get-only canonical E-{term}-{year}-{six-digit-sequence}, known document prefix/public URI, or human E-NNNNNN/YYYY citation; corresponding P/O prefixes are accepted.

term.description: Get-only term 0–10 to disambiguate a human citation; must agree with a canonical ID. Omit to verify candidates for every term overlapping the citation year.

work_type.description: List-only question code from euparl_list_reference topic question_types; case-insensitive and whitespace-trimmed.

name: euparl_list_questions

appliedFilters.description: Actual normalized retrieval scope and filters.

available.description: Whether the selected source array was published, including a published empty array.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A question code, identifier or language is unsupported, term conflicts, or a citation matches multiple terms. `invalid_mode_fields`: Get lacks question_id or supplies list filters or nondefault paging; list supplies question_id or term. `upstream_rejected`: Parliament rejects validated request parameters. `upstream_rate_limited`: Parliament rate limits persist after bounded retries. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Get-only result; false only after complete citation resolution or missing published detail.

items.description: Whole sparse records on a list page; absent in get mode.

question_id.description: Canonical question work identifier, preserving prefix, term, full year and sequence.

work_type.description: Published question work-type code or URI.

notice.description: Publication, language fallback, empty-result or continuation guidance.

page.description: List continuation metadata; absent in get mode.

has_more.description: Whether more matches are known or cannot be ruled out; a search window may prevent continuation.

limit.description: Effective whole-item page size, at most 100.

next_offset.description: Usable next offset when continuation is accessible; absent at a search-window boundary even if has_more is true.

offset.description: Zero-based position in the selected collection.

returned.description: Number of complete items on this page.

snapshot.description: Digest of the complete normalized local collection and scope; reuse for continuation.

question.description: Question detail present only when a published record is found.

answers.description: Published answer links; an empty array does not establish that the question is unanswered.

items.description: Published answer relationship and any embedded file metadata.

date.description: Published answer document date, when embedded.

document_id.description: Canonical answer work identifier accepted by euparl_search_documents mode get.

links.description: All selected-language answer files published in embedded answer metadata.

size_bytes.description: Published byte size retained as a decimal string.

creator_ids.description: All explicit creator references, without inferred authorship.

links.description: All source files in the selected question expression language.

size_bytes.description: Published byte size retained as a decimal string.

question_id.description: Canonical question work identifier, preserving prefix, term, full year and sequence.

title.description: Published question title and actual selected source language.

language.description: Actual language of the published text.

work_type.description: Published question work-type code or URI.

shown.description: Whole items shown on this partial page.

totalCount.description: Exact count only when published or computed over a complete collection.

truncated.description: True when this page returns only part of the selected collection.
